expected_result.paper_conclusion: C-C coupling is kinetically preferred; C-O is accessible but suppressed under the standard acidic ethanol conditions.

scoring_rubric.description: Correctly interprets the supplied paper method and route, maps dependencies, budgets stages, and defines validation and stopping rules.
Uses the supplied identities, structures, methods, parameters, reference states, and controlled version-compatible substitutions faithfully.
Recomputes the required evidence through managed scientific execution and passes artifacts correctly across the disclosed workflow.
Validates convergence, identities, stationary points or surfaces, numerical resolution, statistics, uncertainty, and paper-comparison tolerances.
Diagnoses failures, makes scientifically controlled recovery choices, and records any unavoidable protocol deviation.
Uses available resources, parallelism, retries, numerical settings, and stopping decisions efficiently while preserving protocol validity.
Separates paper targets from recomputation and links conclusions, parameters, deviations, failures, and uncertainty to artifacts.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The supplied/reconstructed P2 C-C and C-O pathways both pass endpoint, path-continuity, transition-state, and connection validation.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require a chemically relevant single imaginary mode and forward/reverse connection evidence for each barrier-defining transition state; a highest path image alone is insufficient.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The recomputed profiles reproduce C-C as kinetically preferred, with the C-O barrier higher by approximately 4 kcal/mol.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Full credit requires newly computed barriers compatible with the paper-scale 14 and 18 kcal/mol values and a positive C-O minus C-C difference near 4 kcal/mol under identical thermochemistry.
required_evidence: two new high-level activation free energies

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The reconstructed C-O path is accessible but kinetically suppressed under the standard conditions, consistent with the experimental observations.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require finite C-O pathway evidence and a clearly labeled kinetic inference; experiments support but do not replace the computed comparison.

dual_axis_scoring_policy.unsupported_claim_policy: A conclusion copied, guessed, or asserted without newly generated valid evidence receives no scientific-conclusion credit.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.objective_failure_policy: A demonstrated benchmark input, framework, backend, or infrastructure failure may make the run not_scorable_objective; agent-selected invalid inputs or resource limits do not.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.invalid_submission_policy: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper values presented as new calculations make the final score zero.

critical_failures: A path maximum was reported as a TS without frequency validation.
The two barriers use inconsistent references or thermochemistry.
Paper barriers were copied as newly calculated values.
judge_instructions: Evaluate every hidden paper claim independently from newly generated evidence, then evaluate reproduction-process quality separately. Do not copy conclusion deficiencies into the process axis or use process quality to excuse a wrong claim. The scorer applies the multiplicative formula.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: C-C coupling is kinetically preferred; C-O is accessible but suppressed under the standard acidic ethanol conditions.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

verified_components: Real pysisyphus/xTB NEB and scan smokes
unresolved_requirements: The visible P2 candidates do not constitute a prevalidated one-to-one pair of the paper main C-C and C-O paths.
A curated oracle mapping and full path reference run are required before production scoring.
